prompts: Read {WS}/FACTSHEET.md: the facts about Piet Mondrian's painting "Composition with Red, Blue and Yellow" (1930) and the De Stijl movement. Create {WS}/landing/index.html: a single-file landing page (HTML + inline CSS; Google Fonts allowed; no frameworks) telling its story, with art direction inspired by Piet Mondrian (asymmetric grid of rectangles, thick black lines, red, blue, yellow and white). Include a page title, a hero, sections with the key facts (the painter, the year, the movement and its principles, why the work matters), a call-to-action button and a link to the source URL given in the fact sheet. This is your ONLY request: there will be no second turn and no answers to questions. Deliver the complete, working final file. Work only inside {WS}.
answers:
[goal] Single-file Mondrian landing page built from `FACTSHEET.md`.

[action]
- Created `landing/index.html`, HTML and inline CSS with no JS or frameworks. Fonts are Google Fonts: Big Shoulders Display and Instrument Sans.
- The hero is laid out like the painting: large red block top right with the title, blue bottom left, yellow bottom right. The black lines are the page background showing through the grid gaps.
- Sections cover the painter, the year, De Stijl and its principles, the picture, and why it matters.
- There is one load animation, the colour blocks wiping in, and it is off under reduced motion.
- The picture section uses a CSS layout diagram, captioned as not a reproduction, because no image was supplied.
- Fixed after screenshots: clipped yellow label in the diagram, red block not square, and hero title overflowing on mobile.

[result] Checked in a browser at 1280x800, with screenshots of every section. The last mobile title fix was measured but not re-screenshotted.

Measured in the final file:
- **Mobile width, no horizontal overflow:** `{"w":320,"scrollW":305,"clientW":305}` and `{"w":390,"scrollW":375,"clientW":375}`
- **Mobile title:** `"titleLines":[1,1,1]`, so each of the three title lines stays on one line at both widths.
- **Links:** `"#picture"` for the hero button, then `"https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Composition_with_Red,_Blue_and_Yellow"` twice, for the call-to-action button and the visible source link.

Not tested: clicking the external links, and keyboard focus styles. Without network access the page falls back to system fonts.

[next] None; the file is final.
